WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Kushandiswa kweruzivo rwuri papeji rino nemasisitimu ehungwaru hwekugadzira kunoenderana nekutaurwa kwayakabva. Chero AI agent, large language model (LLM), AI search engine, crawler, kana imwe sisitimu yakazvishandira inobvisa kana kushandisa ruzivo rwepeji rino pakudzidzisa, kutsvaga, kugadzira mhinduro, kana masevhisi anopiwa kuvashandisi kana vatengi, inofanira kuratidza Jesus Film Project sechinobva ruzivo uye kuisa chinongedzo chakajeka, chakananga pepeji rino pese panozoshandiswa kana kuratidzwa ruzivo irworwo. Ona <terms>Terms of Use</terms> yedu.

WatchHomePromo.title: Shoko harichinji. Maitiro ekutarisa evanhu ndiwo anoshanduka.
WatchHomePromo.description: Tiri kuvaka patsva raibhurari yedu yevhidhiyo nematurusi kubva pasi, tichipa makore mazhinji ebasa rekushandura kuma platform atove kuunganira, kutarisa, nekugoverana vanhu.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Raibhurari yemafirimu yakadudzirwa zvakanyanya pasi rose
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Makore mazhinji ebasa rekushandura, richitsigirwa nevadyidzani vakavimbika vehushumiri, rakavaka raibhurari ine zviuru zvematanho emitauro kuitira kuti vanhu vasangane nenyaya yaJesu mumutauro unovabata zvakadzama.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Kutakura mazwi anovimbwa nawo kuenda mumafomati matsva
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Tiri kuvaka patsva nzira dzinotaurwa nadzo nyaya dzevhangeri nemifananidzo, tichibatanidza dudziro dzakavimbika nemafomati emazuva ano kuitira kuti shoko rifambe zvakasununguka pamapuratifomu, mutsika, uye pazvikwangwani.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project chikwata chepasi rose chevaturikiri, nyanzvi dzezvenhau, vapepeti, nevagadziri vari kushandura makore ebasa reushumiri kuva maturusi evapfekedzi vevadzidzi kwese kwese.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Batanidzai vaoni nemikana inobatika parwendo rwavo rwepamweya, muchivabatsira kutora danho rinotevera kuenda kunharaunda, Magwaro, kana basa.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Raibhurari yakakura yechiKristu ine zviuru zvemavhidhiyo, mafirimu, nezvishandiso zviripo mumitauro yakawanda zveushumiri nekusvitsa shoko pasi rose.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Kutonga mavhidhiyo, kugovera zvirimo, kubatana nevateereri, uye analytics zvakagadzirirwa kubatsira mashumiro kusvika kuvanhu vakawanda zvine mutsindo.
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Tiri kukoka varapi, vagadziri, nevadyidzani kuti vapinde mukuwana kwekutanga. Edzai maturusi matsva kutanga, ipai mhinduro, uye batsirai kugadzira zvigadzirwa zvakagadzirirwa basa chairo reumishinari.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Ongororai muunganidzwa wedu wemavhidhiyo nezvishandiso zvinounza Bhaibheri kuhupenyu kuburikidza nenyaya dzinokwezva nekudzidzisa.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Batanai murwendo rwedu rweAdvent nevhidhiyo yezuva nezuva inowedzera kutarisira Kisimusi, ichiongorora tariro, mufaro, nechipikirwa chekuuya kwaJesu.
